name: Hello Ninja
description: BFFs Wesley and Georgie and their silly cat sidekick Pretzel transform into ninjas and enter a magic world, where they solve problems and save the day.

videos.title: Cottontail Ninja
videos.overview: When a bunny that Wesley's parents are babysitting escapes into the backyard, it's up to the helpful ninja trio to catch it.

videos.title: Lava Leap
videos.overview: Wesley and Georgie must work together to retrieve their new friend Ryan's prized flying disc. But to get it back, they'll have to jump over hot lava!

videos.title: Where Eagles Dare
videos.overview: After watching Wesley and Georgie dunk the basketball with ease, Baa-chan decides to challenge them by raising the rim even higher.

videos.title: Temple of Bingo
videos.overview: A fun night of bingo comes to a halt when a ball goes missing under the table. The ninjas are up to the task to find it, but they need a plan first!

videos.title: Shadow Ninja
videos.overview: While camping in the backyard, Wesley and Georgie suit up as ninjas to find out what's making strange, spooky noises outside.

videos.title: Proof Is in the Pretzel
videos.overview: Pretzel gets blamed for wrecking Mr. Mori's studio, but he didn't do it! Can Wesley and Georgie work together to clear his name?

videos.title: Hound of Ninjaville
videos.overview: Wesley and Georgie power up to protect Pretzel when a new neighbor brings his big, hairy dog over for a backyard barbecue.

videos.title: The Kitchen Mission
videos.overview: Wesley wants to bake his mom's favorite cheesecake for her birthday, but following a recipe exactly as it's written is easier said than done.

videos.title: Coming Clean
videos.overview: Wesley and Georgie drop a can of jelly onto the kitchen floor. They try to get rid of the mess ... but the oozy goo is too slippery to clean up!

videos.title: Bonsai Surprise
videos.overview: When a caterpillar goes missing inside Baa-chan's special bonsai tree, Wesley and Georgie must find the critter before it can do any damage.

videos.title: Market of Doom
videos.overview: When Wesley's mom forgets to pick up milk at the grocery store, it's up to the ninjas to grab a carton without stopping in the aisles for yummy treats.

videos.title: Treasure Split
videos.overview: Baa-chan offers to buy Georgie and Wesley a single item at the Treasure Mart, but they'll have to search together to find something they'll both enjoy.

videos.title: Under the Couch
videos.overview: When Wesley accidentally loses his Jii-chan's prized baseball, the ninjas must face a pirate deep inside the "Cave of Couchiness" to get it back.

videos.title: Wild, Wild Wesley
videos.overview: Sheriff Major Marsha needs to catch up to a train in danger. But with her trusty pony missing, the ninjas set out on a Wild West adventure to find him.

videos.title: Jungle's End
videos.overview: It's burger night! But before they can eat, Wesley and Georgie must first escape the thick vines of their homemade jungle!

videos.title: The Way to Dreamland
videos.overview: Wesley and Georgie are too excited to sleep! But if they don't rest up and reach Dreamland, they'll be too tired to visit the county fair the next day.

videos.title: Lemonade Stand
videos.overview: Wesley and Georgie decide to help Ryan set up his lemonade stand during the local parade — but their sneaky neighbor Zeke has taken all the lemons!

videos.title: Beat the Heat
videos.overview: A day of swimming is canceled when the pool isn't delivered on time. Now the ninjas want to build a waterpark, but a greedy wizard stands in their way.

videos.title: Stick to It
videos.overview: The gang wants to save Max the dinosaur with the chopper Wesley got from his Great Aunt, but they must use their ninja skills to build it first.

videos.title: Ninja vs. Ninja
videos.overview: To find out who the greatest ninja is, Wesley and Georgie race to the top of a mountain! But Baa-chan warns that winning isn't everything.

videos.title: Welcome to Japan
videos.overview: Hello, Japan! With Baa-chan as their guide, the ninjas arrive in her hometown of Osaka. But she forgot to bring the directions to her sister’s house!

videos.title: Hotaru No Hikari
videos.overview: The ninjas plan to release a lantern into the sky, but Wesley’s cousin, Gen, accidentally lets it go before they can put their personal messages inside.

videos.title: Heart of the Dragon
videos.overview: The gang visits a mountaintop shrine. When Gen takes a sparkly rock from the forest, the upset spirit Kodama shows up to get it back.

videos.title: Pretzel Goes to Sea
videos.overview: Oh, no! Pretzel has fleas! Wesley and Georgie want to give him a bath, but the itchy kitty would rather sail away with Greedybeard and become a pirate.

videos.title: Valley of the Giants
videos.overview: It’s up to the ninjas to prove they can do big things when Zeke asks the gang if they’re up for racing older kids on an inflatable obstacle course.

videos.title: Be the Leaves
videos.overview: Wesley’s dad offers Wesley and Georgie a silver dollar each from his collection if they rake up all the leaves in the yard. It's their first real job!

videos.title: Sno Fun
videos.overview: Wesley’s mom and Baa-chan are ready to make pizza. But first, the ninjas must brave the snow to pick up the pizza stone that was just delivered outside.

videos.title: In Cold Pursuit
videos.overview: The ninjas want to get in one last run on their toboggan. They make their way up Snowman Hill, but Gen takes off alone sledding the wrong way!

videos.title: Sneaky Seed Snatcher
videos.overview: A squirrel keeps taking nuts from the bird feeder. But Baa-chan thinks there’s a good reason, urging the ninjas to see the whole picture before they act.

videos.title: A Bike Story
videos.overview: The ninjas are tasked with a mission to pick up a surprise package for Baa-chan, but they’ve never ridden their bikes all the way around the block!

videos.title: No Cat Left Behind
videos.overview: They're coming, Pretzel! Wesley and Georgie must brave the rain as ninjas to rescue their fuzzy feline friend who's trapped in the backyard treehouse.

videos.title: Dance, Dance Ninja
videos.overview: The ninjas aim for the top spot on a dance arcade game, but they’ll have to bust some moves as a team if they want to beat Baa-chan’s high score.

videos.title: The Great Ninja Train
videos.overview: The gang plans to take the ninja dragon train to deliver a tuna sandwich to Wesley's busy father, but the devious Wizard has ideas of his own.

videos.title: The Ballad of Gen
videos.overview: Gen is too excited to take his afternoon nap, so it’s up to Georgie and Wesley to find their ninja calm to help get him to sleep.

videos.title: Let's Talk Space
videos.overview: Astro-ninjas!? Wesley and Georgie set out on a rescue mission through space when Major Marsha flies through a window... into Coach Morgan’s attic.

videos.title: Quiet Game
videos.overview: Shhh! Wesley and Georgie must figure out a way to prevent Gen from playing his recorder before he wakes up a resting Coach Morgan.

videos.title: Golfball Ninjas
videos.overview: A round of mini-golf turns into a ninja mission to dislodge Zeke’s ball that's blocking everyone’s game. But it’ll take the perfect shot!

videos.title: Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: The ninjas embark on a treasure hunt to find the missing half of Baa-chan’s favorite pair of earrings, but now Greedybeard wants it for himself!

videos.title: Enter the Kitten
videos.overview: The ninjas need to keep an eye on a lost kitten until its owner comes to pick it up. But they soon realize they have a wild Kittyzilla on their hands!
